All morning he kept the lamp burning, even after sunrise, turning it by hand, willing its beam to reach across the grey water like an outstretched arm.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市尚未苏醒。街灯在薄雾中泛着昏黄的光晕，像一排沉默的守夜人。环卫工人的扫帚声沿着空旷的马路传来，节奏缓慢而笃定。早餐铺的老板已经拉开半扇卷帘门，热气从蒸笼里升腾而出，带着包子和豆浆的香味弥散在湿凉的空气中。远处高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，车灯划出两道孤独的光线。一只流浪猫蹲在便利店门口，眯着眼打量这个还不属于任何人的时辰。天边隐隐泛出一线靛蓝，黎明正从地平线下慢慢攀爬，整座城市像一个即将翻身的睡者，呼吸渐渐变深。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\"—a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and you want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you how many are behind them, they ask the next person, and so on until the last person says \"zero\"—then everyone adds one and passes the answer forward."}
